entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi... I think I need to return something? I'm just so confused by all of this, I hope I'm doing this right.
Thank you for calling VeloFit support. My name is Alex. I can certainly help you today. Can I start with your order number?
Oh, sure. It's... uh... VF-921-883. It's about some shoes I bought.

Thank you. Pulling that up now... I see the order for the Velo-Pro cycling shoes. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

I'm just so lost. I tried to attach the cleats to the bottom, but the cycling shoes feel so strange when I pedal. I went for just one short ride and they gave me horrible blisters on my heels. I don't know if I did something wrong. Can't you just help me?
I'm very sorry to hear they were so uncomfortable, and I can definitely help. It sounds like it's a sizing or fit issue, which happens sometimes. Let me just check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I see the delivery was 15 days ago. Our standard policy for items like these cycling shoes is 90 days, so you are well within the timeframe for a return.
Oh, really? So I can get a full refund? I was so worried I'd be stuck with them and just wasted all that money.

Yes, absolutely. You are eligible for a full refund. I've just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and you can drop them off with the carrier.
That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Alex. You've made this much less stressful.
You're very welcome. We want you to be happy with your gear. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
